rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-22 FIX iter-21 two-phase BOOTSTRAP: Phase-A denoiser pretrain FROZE (denoise_loss stuck 1.9e-4 all epochs, alpha frozen 0.0862, hr 0.0) because foe_rbf_init_std=0.0 => reg(x)=0 => D(x)=clamp(x-alpha*reg(x))=identity => constant loss => self-vanishing RBF gradient. FIX: foe_rbf_init_std_pretrain=0.05 re-seeds ONLY the FoE synthesis (RBF) weights NON-ZERO at the START of Phase A so reg(x)!=0 => D(x) denoises => gradients flow => FoE LEARNS a real image-domain denoiser; Phase B fine-tunes end-to-end from the TRAINED reg. Model byte-for-byte iter-7 (params==1921, K=5, single scalar alpha, peak lr 5e-3, partial cosine, pretrain_frac 0.40, full 579 pool, max_train_s 1080, val_n 214). Added MANDATORY Phase-A ep1-vs-last decrease guard (assert >=1% drop) the iter-21 run lacked. HYPOTHESIS: working pretrain gives FoE ITNet-like data exposure => warm finetune lower val-RMSE => hr > 0.2515 (pred ~0.26-0.30); if Phase A learns but hr ~0.25 then capacity not training is the bottleneck (clean result).
